lessons: The fence omits chupa/runner.py. Merged chupa/runner.py:437-439 harvest_orphan builds its own Driver.from_config, so startup orphan harvest writes through a separate Journal. That breaks 19.P3.serve-activation's single shared journal. Re-author the seed under 19.L with chupa/runner.py fenced.

Re-grep the harvest_orphan callers before re-authoring: chupa/runner.py:455 and chupa/drain.py:201 pass lambdas into restart. Put every caller whose behavior changes into the caller closure, and keep public signatures and bootstrap reconciliation unchanged.

Do not copy orphan-recovery logic into chupa/serve.py or swap the writer implicitly to stay inside the fence. Under the ticket's Records contract Journal stays the sole durable event writer, and 19.P3.serve-activation requires reusing the real startup reconciliation.

The material does not show how harvest_orphan's Driver and Effects get bound to checkout.journal, and no merged binding was verified here. Read chupa/runner.py and chupa/driver.py before naming one. If none exists, report it as a spec_gap on 19.P3.serve-activation.

Before the next implement attempt, check that the restart preservation tests in tests/test_restart_timers.py still pass on base. Add a test_serve test proving the interrupted-ticket harvest intent and completion events land in the same journal as abandoned.
